title: Tensor coherence of the canonical pullback-square comparison
statement: Let f:X→Y and g:Y′→Y be arbitrary scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], with fibre-product projections f′:X′→Y′ and gX:X′→X [def-pc-fibre-product]. Use derived pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback] and the fixed canonical composition isomorphisms c [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Define α: Lg*⋙Lf′* ≅ Lf*⋙LgX* by c(f′,g), equality transport along the square condition, and c(gX,f) inverse. For all P,Q in the derived category of OY-modules [def-pc-derived-category], the normalized pullback tensor comparisons τ [lem-sc-mixed-hom-tensor-pullback-iso] satisfy Lf′*(τg(P,Q));τf′(Lg*P,Lg*Q);(αP⊗αQ) = α(P⊗Q);LgX*(τf(P,Q));τgX(Lf*P,Lf*Q). No right adjoint, direct-image pairing, or base-change map occurs in this equality.

proof.text: Apply the K-flat composition/tensor triangle to any two composable scheme arrows on localized K-flat complexes. Use the already constructed SingleComplexBaseChange K-flat coordinates to represent arbitrary P,Q. Form the two natural transformations from tensor followed by the composite pullback to the tensor of composite-arrow pullbacks: the composite tensorator followed by the tensor of c, and c at the tensor followed by the composite-arrow tensorator. Their components agree on the representatives by the triangle. Precompose both arbitrary-input components with the invertible map induced by the pair of representative isomorphisms; naturality transports the representative equality, and cancellation proves the triangle for arbitrary inputs. This extension is the proved private composition_tensor helper.

Compatibility of an isomorphism with tensor comparisons is closed under composition: expand the tensor of two composites with tensorHom_comp_tensorHom and substitute the two compatibility equations. It is closed under inverse: precompose the desired inverse equation with c at the tensor, substitute the forward equation, and cancel hom followed by inv, including its tensor product. For equal scheme arrows, eliminate their equality proof; eqToIso becomes the identity and compatibility is id_tensorHom_id and the category identity laws. These are the proved generic trans/symm and equality_tensor helpers.

Apply the arbitrary-input triangle to snd followed by g and to fst followed by f. Apply equality_tensor to the symmetric square condition snd≫g=fst≫f. Compose the first triangle, this equality compatibility, and the inverse of the second triangle. The resulting compatible comparison is (c(snd,g) followed by equality transport) followed by c(fst,f) inverse. Iso.trans_assoc identifies it with the original right-associated mixedPullbackSquareComparison. Expand only composite tensorator components and reassociate categorical compositions to obtain the unchanged displayed square equality. No base-change map is used or cancelled.

lean.statement:
theorem mixedPullbackSquareComparison_tensor
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) :
    (derivedPullback (pullback.snd f g)).map
        ((mixedHomTensorPullbackIso g).hom.app (P, Q)) ≫
      (mixedHomTensorPullbackIso (pullback.snd f g)).hom.app
        ((derivedPullback g).obj P, (derivedPullback g).obj Q) ≫
      ((mixedPullbackSquareComparison f g).hom.app P ⊗ₘ
        (mixedPullbackSquareComparison f g).hom.app Q) =
    (mixedPullbackSquareComparison f g).hom.app (P ⊗ Q) ≫
      (derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).map
        ((mixedHomTensorPullbackIso f).hom.app (P, Q)) ≫
      (mixedHomTensorPullbackIso (pullback.fst f g)).hom.app
        ((derivedPullback f).obj P, (derivedPullback f).obj Q)
